author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Lucy, a 2D action-adventure side-scrolling platformer developed by Cerki Games. Players will embark on a critical quest to rescue Lucy's friends by taking out enemies, overcoming platforming challenges, and exploring a suite of locations along the way. Lucy is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Lucy - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a fresh look at Flick in this latest trailer for the upcoming first-person body-cam horror game. Shift realities with the flick of a light switch and plunge into the grotesque to uncover your repressed and twisted past. Flick is a psychological horror game where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons. Flick will be available on PC on November 19, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Flick - Official Demo Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
He was built to dominate, born from rage, and he's never let go of it. Meet Kaizu in this latest Morbid Metal trailer for the hack-and-slash roguelike game, and see this fourth playable character in action. Kaizu is a close-range brawler who leaps into the fight, softens up his targets, and unloads everything in one devastating hit.

Morbid Metal is out now in PC Early Access.
title: Morbid Metal - Official Kaizu Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet the fighters of Dragon Ball GT in this latest Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero Super-Limit Breaking Neo trailer for the fighting game's DLC. The trailer spotlights Vegeta (GT), Trunks (GT), Vegeta (GT) Super Saiyan, Nuova Shenron (GT), and more. Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero's Super-Limit Breaking Neo DLC is available now.
title: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero Super-Limit Breaking Neo - Official Dragon Ball GT Character Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Ride the storm toward uncharted seas, enchanted forests, and ancient forges in the latest Age of Wonders 4 expansion pass. Watch the latest Age of Wonders 4 trailer for the strategy game for a behind-the-scenes look at what to expect from the Expansion Pass 4, which brings together four content releases into a single bundle, starting with Singer of Storms Insta Unlock, available immediately.

Set sail for The Silver Seas on November 3, 2026. Court of the Archfey launches in Q1 2027 and Forge of the Firstborn arrives in Q2 2027.

Age of Wonders 4: Expansion Pass 4 is available to purchase now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.
title: Age of Wonders 4 - Official Expansion Pass 4 Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Freddy Krueger Trailer for Fortnite, the hit third-person action battle royale shooter developed by Epic Games. Players will slash their way to a Victory Royale with the Freddy Krueger skin just in time for spooky season. The Freddy Krueger skin is available now in the Item Shop in Fortnite.
title: Fortnite - Official Freddy Krueger Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Red Skies at Dawn, a first-person sailing adventure game developed by Junklab. Players will take to the seas on a yacht to take in the scenic views, navigate treacherous waters, and seek shelter when the weather turns. Red Skies at Dawn is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Red Skies at Dawn - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest Permafrost trailer for this upcoming story-driven survival sandbox set in a frozen, post-apocalyptic world. The new trailer showcases the brutal world, gameplay, and more. In Permafrost, discover a vast lore-rich open world, alone or in co-op with up to 4 players. Explore, scavenge, craft, and build a network of shelters to outlast the cold. Permafrost will be available in Steam Early Access on October 9, 2026.
title: Permafrost - Official Early Access Release Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Transylvania Reveal Trailer for Subway Surfers, the hit endless runner developed by Sybo Games. Players will take in the spooky season in stride with the Transylvania World Tour Update, packed with new characters, outfits, and new boards to collect. The Transylvania World Tour Update for Subway Surfers runs from October 5 through November 1 for iOS and Android.
title: Subway Surfers - Official Transylvania World Tour Update Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Launch Trailer for MXGP 26 - The Official Game, the hit motocross racing game developed by Artefacts Studio. Players will engage with the title's new motorcycle physics, rider animations, and dynamic deformation technology across iconic tracks around the world. Race for glory in MXGP 26 - The Official Game, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: MXGP 26 - The Official Game - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Mobile Launch Trailer for River City Survivors: Downtown of the Dead, a survivors-like action mobile game developed by ARC System Works. Players will do what's necessary to survive the endless onslaught with over 20 playable characters, special attacks, and items to take advantage of. River City Survivors: Downtown of the Dead is available now exclusively on Apple Arcade.
title: River City Survivors: Downtown of the Dead - Official Mobile Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the ‘Cerberax’ Fantastic Tames Season 1 Trailer for ARK: Survival Ascended, the hit survival action-adventure RPG developed by Studio Wildcard. Players can become familiar with the Cerberax as one of the three beasts in the Fantastic Tames Season 1 offering, with their signature three-headed design covering fire, venom, and electrical-based attacks. Meet the Cerberax in ARK: Survival Ascended, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: ARK: Survival Ascended - Official ‘Cerberax’ Fantastic Tames Season 1 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the 1943 Minami, Osaka Overview Trailer for Stranger Than Heaven, an upcoming narrative-driven action game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio. Players will explore multiple eras across a suite of cities, including 1943 Minami, Osaka where show business is at the heart of the location. Stranger Than Heaven is launching on January 15 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
title: Stranger Than Heaven - Official 1943 Minami, Osaka Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Accolades Trailer for Control Resonant, the hit third-person action-adventure sequel developed by Remedy. Players will go beyond the walls of the Oldest House as Dylan Faden to traverse a Manhattan that's fallen to the paranormal. Harness powerful abilities and fight for the city in Control Resonant, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Control Resonant - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Rise Above Trailer for Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve, the latest installment to the hit jet dogfighting game developed by Bandai Namco Aces. Players can witness Brand Director Kazutoki Kono-san taking to the skies in a real Mig21 to feel the thrill of Ace Combat in real life. Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Official Rise Above Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the ‘Call to Glory’ Update Gameplay Overview Trailer for Farever, an open-world action-adventure RPG developed by Shiro Games. Players can get a look at the new update for the game, introducing a new Heroic difficulty for dungeons and bosses, gear, enhanced multiplayer rewards, social features, and more. The ‘Call to Glory’ Update for Farever is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Farever - Official ‘Call to Glory’ Update Gameplay Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Update 1 Launch Trailer for LumenTale: Memories of Trey, a creature-collecting action RPG developed by Beehive Studios. Players can check out a host of new quality-of-life changes, new Lost Animon variants, stability improvements, and more with the latest update to the game. Update 1 for LumenTale: Memories of Trey is available now for Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam).
title: LumenTale: Memories of Trey - Official Update 1 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Arjun Character Guide for Street Fighter 6, the latest installment in the hit fighting game franchise developed by Capcom. Players can check out Arjun's fighting techniques, moveset, abilities, and more with over 8 minutes of gameplay. Fight as Arjun on October 13, when he launches into Street Fighter 6 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
title: Street Fighter 6 - Official Arjun Character Guide

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the trailer for GOAT, an upcoming dress-up roguelike deckbuilder with a 2000s-inspired Flash art style. GOAT will be available on PC. A demo for GOAT is out now on Steam.

In GOAT, which stands for Gear Optimization Auto-battle Tactics, an evil goat has stolen all your clothes, and it’s your job to win them back piece by piece. Players equip clothing and weapons with different stats and attributes, combining them to create powerful synergies and builds before sending their character into battle.
title: GOAT (Gear Optimization Auto-battle Tactics) - Official Demo Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this teaser for Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 campaign mode. Taking us to North Korea for the first time in the series, get a peek inside the world of Modern Warfare 4's gritty narrative. With a full-scale invasion into South Korea orchestrated by North Korea, a band of young South Korean infantrymen fight against incredible odds, while on the other side of the world a rage-fuelled Captain Price wages a personal war from the shadows. 
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is launching on October 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam, BattleNet).
title: Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 - Official "Sacrifice" Teaser

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest trailer for Don't Fret, a new Horror first person game from Digital Pajamas and Scary Kid Studios. You awaken as a sentient guitar, trapped in Harmonic Heights, a prestigious music school. Use stealth, your smarts and a guitar tuner to escape the nightmare and uncover the mystery! 

Don't Fret is coming Winter 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Don't Fret - Official Winter Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for The Internal, a time-based action roguelike developed by STUDIOPLAYER3. Players will fight within the corporate ladder of a tech company as time works against them. Be prepared for ever-shifting rooms, master the three weapon types, and rise as the intern who takes on the coworkers. The Internal is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: The Internal - Official Demo Launch Trailer
